audit.whatIsWrong: Fling is repeatedly called his W. Fling is E (125 range, 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s); W is Mega Adhesive. The page also told the user to hold Steadfast Presence to stop the Fling — W stops dashes, not a displacement applied to you, and Singed has no dash at all.
audit.why: Two consequences the page never stated: Mega Adhesive grounds, so standing in the goo shuts off your own E dash and W; and Fling knocks you up, which cancels Keeper's Verdict mid-channel.
audit.corrected: Fling named as E with its cooldown, Mega Adhesive named as the grounding zone that denies your E, and the R-cancel written in (the flagged missing interaction). The W-stops-his-fling advice is removed.

edits.before: Singed kites your whole team with W fling, poison trail and Rylai's slow — your single CC can't pin a champion built to never be caught.
edits.after: Singed kites your whole team with Fling, Poison Trail and Rylai's slow — your single CC can't pin a champion built to never be caught.

edits.before: Singed is one of the few melee-ish lanes where you can actually press your buttons early — he has no dash for your W to deny, but he also has nothing to fear from it. At levels 2-3 your real window opens: bait him to walk up, E him into a wall for the stun and hammer the max-HP Q while he's pinned. Watch the W fling — if he flips you toward his minions or your tower you eat free poison, so trade with your back to safety, not his. Don't chase him into his poison trail; his sustain and move speed mean a long chase always ends with you taking more than him.
edits.after: Singed is one of the few lanes where you can press your buttons early — he has no dash for your W to deny, but he has nothing to fear from it either. At levels 2-3 your window opens: bait him to walk up, E him into a wall for the stun and hammer the max-HP Q while he's pinned. Watch Fling (E, 10s) — it flips you behind him into his minions or your tower for free poison, so trade with your back to safety. And never start a trade standing in Mega Adhesive: the goo grounds you, so your E dash simply will not fire.

edits.before: Late game is Singed's, not yours. He's built specifically to be the one champion your single CC can't lock — Rylai's slow, poison trail and W fling let him run down your carries while your E needs a wall and your R is one displacement on a long cooldown. Your job stops being the duel and becomes peel: hold W to deny his fling on your ADC, tap-R him off when he commits, and body-block the poison lane. You stay relevant as a disruptor, but you never catch a Singed who doesn't want to be caught.
edits.after: Late game is Singed's, not yours. He's built to be the one champion your single CC can't lock — Rylai's slow, Poison Trail and Fling let him run down your carries while your E needs a wall and your R is one displacement on a long cooldown. Your job stops being the duel and becomes peel: stand between him and your ADC, tap-R him off the moment he commits, and body-block the poison lane. Never channel a full R with his Fling up — the knockup cancels it outright.
